confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Koh Samui pricing for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by beach and season. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker and were set using the typical beach-bar and restaurant markup over beer. Hostel and 3-star hotel anchors carry the widest uncertainty. The FX figure comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Thai island and resort-town pricing (Koh Samui sits between mainland Thai towns and Phuket/Krabi in tourist-facing prices). Prices are assumed to be typical for a July low-to-shoulder season.
